review_description: SolarQuotes recommended suppliers focused on Chinese panels. We do not want Chinese products and avoid them where possible.Sales/quoting process was excellent from one and average from another. The 3rd supplier did contact us but well after we committed.Installation: Polite? Tidy? Punctual? Yes, all of those.How was the customer service? Yes, grid connect all handled by supplier. Also available to answer stupid customer questions post sale, and with a smile. Lovely fellow.
